# Universal Convertor

> Universal Convertor is a free, private browser-based converter for images, documents and date. Files are processed locally and are never uploaded.

The application converts PNG, JPEG, WebP, AVIF, HEIC, SVG, BMP, ICO, GIF, TIFF, PSD, JSON, CSV, TSV, Markdown, HTML, XML, and plain text. Image processing uses browser APIs and Web Workers. ZIP archives and merged PDFs are generated on the user's device.

The converter validates file content, sanitizes SVG input, and keeps file data in browser memory. No account is required.

## Resources

- [Universal Convertor website](https://convertor.apidevelopers.ir/): Open the browser-based converter.
